fact: ONECI director-general Ago Christian Kodia said a parent's national identity card now supplies the identity information directly on the new birth-registration terminal.

AIP reports that the civil-registry digitisation reform is piloted by ONECI, the national office for civil status and identification, with all civil registration centres equipped with Citiweb software at end 2025.

ONECI, the national civil-status and identification office, is training 44 civil-registry agents in the Goh region from 27 July 2026 on its Citiweb software for capturing births, marriages and deaths.
